architect_rulings.quest_data_excerpt:
| Case | Ruling |
|---|---|
| Container chests (a filled container) | **Covered.** BAGS-0 (containers with contents) is the nested-bags decision that the reward-chest slice §5.1 waited on. A contents field in the quest reward schema is a content-lane child after close-out. Until then, these rows stay `waiting_data`. |
| Key chests | **Covered.** Quest format §3/§3.1 `reward.key_binding` (`…:door-key/<n>`) and DUR-03 §39.3. Author them now. |
| Text chests (book or letter) | **Covered.** Quest format §3 `reward.written_text` and WRITE-0 (merged). Author them now. |
| Random chests | **Covered.** Quest format §3 `reward.random_one_of` and QUEST-STATE-0 §8 (CHEST-RANDOM-1). Author them now. |
| Cooldown chests | **Covered.** Quest format `repeat: cooldown(hours)`, with identity per reward-chest §5.1 (claim, character, cycle ordinal). Author the data now; the runtime is a later child. |
| Achievement chests | **New architecture item after close-out** (an Achievement owner, per reward-chest §6). Author the typed grant reference; the claim records the grant request. Runtime admission waits for that item. |
| Item 3081 (charged amulet) | **Covered.** The reward is **one** ItemInstance with count 1. Its 5 charges come from the Item definition's `charges.count` (item schema; EQUIP-0 §3.1), never from the reward line. Add the charges fact from TibiaWiki first. The charge behaviour itself waits for TIMED-ITEM-0 (EQUIP-0: `timed` items grant nothing until then). |
| Conditions or effects outside the closed vocabulary | **Stay `unresolved`/`waiting_data`.** Group them by kind in the closeout packet. Each new kind is a new architecture item after close-out. Do not widen the vocabulary in data. |

Integrating this owner-directed continuation into the D252 close-out schedule is the control plane's call.

charge_evidence.rule: The chest helper passes exactly itemid and count to addItem. For a charged non-stackable Item that second argument is a subtype: one Item carrying that many charges. The original source count is retained; native lowering is not performed.
